propositions: The audit page renderer at page.py:329 currently only accepts kind='operator-attested' when determining if a criterion is lacking, but must also accept kind='non-codebase' to handle immutable historical records before S5 schema changes

827 of 4,285 live store tickets have COMPLETION_VERDICT events with kind='operator-attested' that cannot be rewritten, so the reader must support both values to avoid silently stopping flagging un-attested criteria on old records
The kind field comparison at page.py:329 is the only site in the codebase that validates criterion kind against a string literal, making this change localized with minimal blast radius
A criterion with kind='operator-attested' and met=false must render with lacking=true
A criterion with kind='non-codebase' and met=false must render with lacking=true
A criterion with kind='codebase-verifiable' must remain unaffected regardless of met value
